intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (2) Kalterer Höhe/Caldaro Alta (54.7 km

story: A large breakaway formed early, featuring stage winners Lennart Jasch and Tom Pidcock, but was gradually reeled in. INEOS Grenadiers reduced the peloton before Giulio Pellizzari attacked with 20 km to go. He rode solo to victory, securing the overall, ahead of Egan Bernal and Thymen Arensman.
